label: Rival: some being with the nine listed attributes lacks the classical divine attributes
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed, motivated by the fuller list of Dei Filius ch. 1 (omnipotent, immense, incomprehensible) and by accounts on which omnipotence, omniscience or omnipresence are not contained in the nine: some being is simple, perfect, good, one, infinite, immutable, eternal and has intellect and will, and does not have the classical divine attributes of the skeleton. The replacement account is that the classical profile has further members which the nine predicates, as encoded, do not entail; the formal statement does not say which. It is the exact negation of STMT-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-SUFFICE on the same signature and predicates.
